abstract: Covers Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core Object Specification (iCalendar). RFC 5545 Internet Calendaring and Scheduling Core Object Specification (iCalendar) is current; RFC 7265 jCal: The JSON Format for iCalendar is current; RFC 8984 JSCalendar: A JSON Representation of Calendar Data is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
